<script>

export default {
  name: 'RiderHome',
  components: { BottomNav },
  data() {
    return {
      acceptedOrders: [
        {
          id: 1001,
          merchantName: "麦当劳",
          merchantAddress: "美食街18号",

          merchantAddress: "西门小吃街3号摊位",
          userAddress: "宿舍楼B区506",
          createTime: "2025-05-23 14:30"
        },
        {
          id: 2003,
          merchantName: "星巴克",
          merchantAddress: "图书馆一楼",
          userAddress: "行政楼305",
          createTime: "2025-05-23 15:00"
        },
        {
          id: 2004,
          merchantName: "食堂二楼",
          merchantAddress: "学生食堂二楼8号窗口",
          userAddress: "宿舍楼C区302",
          createTime: "2025-05-23 15:30"
        }
      ],
      userLocation: null,
      navItems: [
        { label: '订单搜索', action: () => { this.$router.push('/rider/orders') } },
        { label: '历史订单', action: () => { this.$router.push('/rider/history') } },
        { label: '个人中心', action: () => { /* 暂时不跳转 */ } }
      ]
    }
  },
  computed: {
    ...mapState('riderStore', ['riderId'])
  },
  methods: {
    goToOrderDetail(orderId) {
      this.$router.push(`/rider/order/${orderId}`)
    },
    
    // 获取当前地理位置
    getCurrentLocation() {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        // 模拟地理位置
        setTimeout(() => {
          resolve({
            latitude: 39.9042,
            longitude: 116.4074
          })
        }, 1000)
      })
    },

    // 获取已接订单 (暂时使用本地数据)
    async fetchAcceptedOrders() {
      // 真实环境下的代码：
      // try {
      //   const params = new URLSearchParams({ riderId: this.riderId }).toString()

      //   const result = await response.json()
      //   if (result.success && Array.isArray(result.data)) {
      //     this.acceptedOrders = result.data
      //   } else {

      //   }
      // } catch (e) {
      //   console.error('获取已接订单失败', e)
      //   this.acceptedOrders = []
      // }
      console.log('获取已接订单 (使用本地数据)')
    },

    // 获取推荐订单 (暂时使用本地数据)
    async fetchRecommendedOrders() {
      // 模拟获取地理位置
      if (!this.userLocation) {
        this.userLocation = await this.getCurrentLocation()
      }
      
      // 真实环境下的代码：
      // try {
      //   const params = new URLSearchParams({
      //     riderId: this.riderId,
      //     latitude: this.userLocation.latitude,
      //     longitude: this.userLocation.longitude
      //   }).toString()
      //   
      //   const response = await fetchWithTimeout(`${BASE_URL}/rider/recommendedorders?${params}`)
      //   const result = await response.json()
      //   if (result.success && Array.isArray(result.data)) {
      //     this.recommendedOrders = result.data.slice(0, 10)
      //   } else {
      //     this.recommendedOrders = []
      //   }
      // } catch (e) {
      //   console.error('获取推荐订单失败', e)
      //   this.recommendedOrders = []
      // }
      console.log('获取推荐订单 (使用本地数据)')
    },

    // 刷新推荐订单
    async refreshRecommendedOrders() {
      this.userLocation = null
      await this.fetchRecommendedOrders()
      // 模拟刷新效果
      const newOrder = {
        id: Date.now(),
        merchantName: "新推荐商家",
        merchantAddress: "新地址" + Math.floor(Math.random() * 100) + "号",
        userAddress: "新用户地址" + Math.floor(Math.random() * 100) + "号",
        createTime: new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN', { 
          year: 'numeric', 
          month: '2-digit', 
          day: '2-digit', 
          hour: '2-digit', 
          minute: '2-digit' 
        })
      }
      this.recommendedOrders.unshift(newOrder)
      if (this.recommendedOrders.length > 10) {
        this.recommendedOrders.pop()
      }
    },

    // 更新订单状态 (使用本地数据模拟)
    async updateOrderStatus(orderId) {
      const order = this.acceptedOrders.find(o => o.id === orderId)
      if (!order) return

      // 模拟网络请求
      const success = Math.random() > 0.2 // 80% 成功率
      
      if (success) {
        if (order.status === 'accepted') {
          order.status = 'picked'
        } else {
          // 订单完成，从已接订单中移除
          const index = this.acceptedOrders.findIndex(o => o.id === orderId)
          if (index !== -1) {
            this.acceptedOrders.splice(index, 1)
          }
        }
      } else {
        alert('状态更新失败：网络错误')
      }

      // 真实环境下的代码：
      // const nextStatus = order.status === 'accepted' ? 'picked' : 'completed'
      // try {
      //   const response = await fetchWithTimeout(`${BASE_URL}/rider/updateorder`, {
      //     method: 'POST',
      //     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      //     body: JSON.stringify({ 
      //       riderId: this.riderId,
      //       orderId,
      //       status: nextStatus
      //     })
      //   })
      //   const result = await response.json()
      //   if (result.success) {
      //     if (nextStatus === 'picked') {
      //       order.status = 'picked'
      //     } else {
      //       const index = this.acceptedOrders.findIndex(o => o.id === orderId)
      //       if (index !== -1) {
      //         this.acceptedOrders.splice(index, 1)
      //       }
      //     }
      //     await this.fetchAcceptedOrders()
      //     await this.fetchRecommendedOrders()
      //   } else {
      //     alert('状态更新失败：' + (result.message || '未知错误'))
      //   }
      // } catch (e) {
      //   alert('网络错误，状态更新失败')
      // }
    },

    // 抢单 (使用本地数据模拟)
    async grabOrder(orderId) {
      // 模拟网络请求
      const success = Math.random() > 0.3 // 70% 成功率
      
      if (success) {
        alert('抢单成功！')
        // 将订单从推荐列表移除并添加到已接订单
        const orderIndex = this.recommendedOrders.findIndex(o => o.id === orderId)
        if (orderIndex !== -1) {
          const grabbedOrder = this.recommendedOrders.splice(orderIndex, 1)[0]
          grabbedOrder.status = 'accepted'
          this.acceptedOrders.push(grabbedOrder)
        }
      } else {
        alert('抢单失败：该订单可能已被其他骑手接取')
      }

      // 真实环境下的代码：
      // try {
      //   const response = await fetchWithTimeout(`${BASE_URL}/rider/chooseorder`, {
      //     method: 'POST',
      //     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      //     body: JSON.stringify({ 
      //       riderId: this.riderId,
      //       orderId 
      //     })
      //   })
      //   const result = await response.json()
      //   if (result.success) {
      //     alert('抢单成功！')
      //     await this.fetchAcceptedOrders()
      //     await this.fetchRecommendedOrders()
      //   } else {
      //     alert('抢单失败：' + (result.message || '该订单可能已被其他骑手接取'))
      //   }
      // } catch (e) {
      //   alert('网络错误，抢单失败')
      // }
    }
  },
  
  async mounted() {
    await this.fetchAcceptedOrders()
    await this.fetchRecommendedOrders()
  }
}
</script>
